description: This file defines the SqliteSaver class, which manages checkpoint storage and retrieval in an SQLite database, including methods for listing, getting, putting, and deleting checkpoints, as well as handling chat messages.

classes.name: SqliteSaver
classes.description: A class for saving and retrieving checkpoints and chat messages using SQLite, implementing MemoryMethods.

methods.name: sanitizeTableName
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates a table name to ensure it contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new DataSource instance based on configuration options.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Creates the checkpoints table in the database if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getTuple
methods.description: Retrieves a checkpoint tuple from the database based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists checkpoint tuples with optional limit and pagination.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a checkpoint and its metadata into the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes checkpoints associated with a specific thread ID.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages associated with a session ID, optionally converting to base messages.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Clears chat messages for a given session ID.
